items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: Alton Redd made them. And Alton Redd made them for Dr. Exner. I was in the Army then, I think, when they made them.

ctx.x: Speaking of records, were you on that first date with Kid Ory, those Sunshine records for the Spikes Brothers?
No, no, no, Alton Redd. Boy out here, I'll call Alton Redd.
But I mean way back in 1921.
